actions.action: Separate visible-page selection from all matching records
actions.mechanism: Explicit scope choices distinguish the 25 visible records from the 600 matching records before confirmation.
actions.implementation: Provide separate labeled controls. Show a persistent summary: count, filter description, target status, and whether selection spans pages.
actions.check: Using keyboard only, select each scope; verify the confirmation and submitted ID count agree, including after page navigation.
actions.risk: A generic “Select all” label would reintroduce ambiguity.

actions.action: Freeze the exact confirmed record set
actions.mechanism: An immutable ID manifest prevents changing filters or new matches from silently expanding the confirmed operation.
actions.implementation: Resolve matching IDs before confirmation; bind confirmation to that manifest. Execute explicit manifest IDs, never rerun the filter for membership.
actions.check: Add matching records and change filters after confirmation; assert every dispatched ID belongs to the original confirmed manifest.
actions.risk: Resolving the manifest may delay confirmation; expose progress.

actions.action: Reject records changed since the confirmed snapshot
actions.mechanism: Atomic version preconditions prevent overwriting intervening edits, while unchanged records can still succeed independently.
actions.implementation: Capture record versions with the manifest. Add server-side conditional updates that atomically compare each version and return conflicts as per-record outcomes.
actions.check: Change one record between confirmation and execution; verify that record reports conflict and retains its newer state while others proceed.
actions.risk: Client-side checks alone leave a race window.

actions.action: Preserve a resumable per-record operation receipt
actions.mechanism: Durable outcomes distinguish completed changes, failures, and unresolved requests even when navigation or network interruption hides progress.
actions.implementation: Persist operation ID, confirmed manifest, and per-record outcomes. Restore a receipt showing succeeded, failed, conflicted, pending, and unknown counts.
actions.check: Interrupt a batch and reload; verify restored counts reconcile with the manifest and unresolved records are not labeled successful.
actions.risk: Lost responses require server reconciliation, not guessed outcomes.

actions.action: Retry failures without replaying successful changes
actions.mechanism: Outcome-based retry sets and server-side deduplication isolate recovery from work that has already completed successfully.
actions.implementation: Offer “Retry failed records.” Enforce original-manifest membership, exclude successes, reconcile unknown outcomes, and deduplicate writes by operation and record.
actions.check: Mix successes, failures, and lost responses; retry twice and verify successes receive no additional writes and no outside IDs appear.
actions.risk: Conflicts require refreshed information and renewed confirmation before overwrite.

actions.action: Make reversal eligibility explicit for each record
actions.mechanism: A reversal receipt explains whether the deadline elapsed or a subsequent change prevents restoring the earlier status.
actions.implementation: Store prior status, resulting version, and server deadline. Atomically reverse only eligible confirmed IDs; show textual per-record reasons when unavailable.
actions.check: Test unchanged, subsequently edited, expired, and edited-back records; only eligible records reverse, and every rejection displays its actual reason.
actions.risk: Displayed eligibility can expire before activation; revalidate server-side.

actions.action: Make the whole workflow keyboard and screen-reader operable
actions.mechanism: Semantic controls, predictable focus, and concise announcements expose scope and outcomes without depending on pointer interaction or color.
actions.implementation: Use labeled native controls, a navigable scope summary, throttled live progress, and keyboard-accessible outcome filters. Preserve focus when rows update.
actions.check: Complete selection, confirmation, failure recovery, and reversal using only keyboard and screen reader; verify counts and rejection reasons are discoverable.
actions.risk: Announcing every record outcome would overwhelm the workflow.
